title: K-flat tensor preserves cohomological vanishing at a point
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], P and J cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], e_A:Q(P) ≅ A, and J K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. At any point x of X, if every cohomology sheaf of A has zero stalk at x, then every cohomology sheaf of Q(Tot(P tensor J)) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] has zero stalk at x. No K-flatness of P, perfectness, affine hypothesis, or closed subset is needed.

source.place: Tag 06YB; exactness of stalks and the support argument accompanying Tag 08EH

proof.text: The module stalk functor is exact: the sheaf-to-abelian-sheaf functor preserves finite limits and colimits, and the abelian sheaf stalk functor is exact by Mathlib. Reflect through the faithful module-to-abelian-group functor. Its homology comparison and the homology factors of Q transport the hypothesis along e_A to acyclicity of the stalk complex P_x.
Apply the forward stalk K-flat criterion to J and the acyclic complex P_x. Thus Tot(P_x tensor J_x) is acyclic.

Use the stalk-total-tensor isomorphism to transfer acyclicity to the stalk of Tot(P tensor J). Exactness of the stalk functor, its homology comparison and the Q homology factors identify its zero homology with the cohomology stalks of Q(Tot(P tensor J)). In ModuleCat, a zero object has a subsingleton underlying type.

    (X : Scheme.{uX})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (P J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A)
    (hJ : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) J) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj A).val.presheaf x))) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _)))).val.presheaf x))
